coordinator: Codex root; sole global progress and integration writer

publication_review.public_allowed: Only validated staged inventory, self-authored factual metadata, source links and byte/hash manifests; original labels remain unverified. Source URLs must remain sanitized by tool.
public_forbidden: Original CSV bytes or full rule/source prose
raw market data or full papers/web pages
personal annotations, credentials, signed URLs or private runtime dumps
publication_review.stage_bytes: After field review, copy entire immutable stage output with no edits into permitted batch directory. If unsafe fields are found, keep that batch private and report; do not silently edit outputs or relax schema.
publication_review.private_library: Preserve full private plan and all validated batch archives with independent manifests; report exact Library IDs and recovery receipts privately to parent/root.

handoff_per_batch: batch_id and original record ID count
Library backup identity plus recovery verification receipt (private channel)
remote branch commit and exact readback verification
integration_owner: Root reviews each bounded PR and appends records/index on an independent integration branch; dot never writes top-level metadata records or global progress.
continue_policy: Do not wait for this executor Library download; dot uses its already verified source bytes. New collection intake remains paused until original corpus remote acceptance.
